note: 'Ezra the priest selected men who were family heads... sat down to examine the matter'; 'they had dealt with all the men who had married foreign women'
'So Ezra got up and made the leading priests, Levites, and all Israel take an oath'
'Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women'. The verse addresses them in the second person rather than naming the class.
'They pledged to send their wives away'
